title: A Mandate Is Not Permanent Authorization
summary: A dependency map connecting mandate scope and conditions to baselines, monitoring, appeals, time and event triggers, renewed participation, adaptive decision, remedy, sunset, and retirement.
map_question: What keeps a public authorization bounded, reviewable, appealable, and capable of amendment, reversal, sunset, or retirement?
interpretation_boundary: Initial authorization, elapsed time, continued funding, contract renewal, implementation activity, participation, or reported benefit does not establish permanent mandate, successful conditions, silent renewal, or immunity from review.

nodes.label: Benefit, harm, burden, access, and distribution baselines
nodes.note: Review needs a registered starting point.

nodes.label: Monitoring, complaints, incidents, challenges, and appeals
nodes.note: Operating and public evidence remains open to correction.

nodes.label: Scheduled and event-based reopening triggers
nodes.note: Time, performance, harm, context, authority, and future-user changes can open review.

nodes.label: Renewed standing, notice, participation, and public reason
nodes.note: The affected public and evidence can change.

nodes.label: Continue, condition, amend, pause, reverse, sunset, or retire
nodes.note: A human decision selects the bounded response.

nodes.label: Adaptive decision, remedy, archive, and receipt
nodes.note: No adaptive decision or receipt exists.

links.note: Monitoring compares observed evidence with the registered state.
Only defined evidence can activate review.
A trigger opens process; it does not decide the outcome.
New reasons and affected-public evidence inform a separate decision.
Mandate change, remedy, and archive need a receipt.

what_this_map_supports: Explicit mandate scope, conditions, duration, sunset, appeal, indicators, and triggers.
Renewed standing and participation when material conditions change.
Separate continuation, amendment, reversal, sunset, and retirement decisions.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish a current mandate, trigger, review, benefit, harm, or failure.
It does not authorize silent renewal or automatic extension.
It does not create a score, rank, stage advance, or operating-outcome change.
next_records_needed: A completed Phase 77 legitimacy audit and mandate receipt.
Registered baselines, indicators, complaints, incidents, appeals, and trigger criteria.
A real trigger followed by renewed public process and an adaptive decision receipt.
